audience: service businesses managing staff calendars and customer bookings in Bookafy

useCases.title: Review a staff calendar
useCases.text: Find a staff member and review their appointments in a selected UTC date range, including the customer, service and booking status.

useCases.title: Share a self-booking link
useCases.text: Look up appointment types and their public booking links so a customer can choose a service and book through Bookafy.

useCases.title: Find a customer record
useCases.text: Search customers by name, email or phone and inspect the matching contact details before making a booking.

useCases.title: Reschedule an appointment
useCases.text: Review the current appointment, staff and service, then change the selected booking when requested. Bookafy may notify the customer.
